title: Commando 3
desc: Officers Karan and Bhavana travel to London on a high-stakes mission after uncovering a threat to India, racing against time to foil a planned terrorist attack.

title: Kasme Vaade
desc: Raju, guilt-ridden over his brother's death, meets Amit's lookalike, Shankar, and unknowingly becomes entangled in a deeper mystery, making amends while facing unsettling truths.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Super Singh
desc: Super Singh, a carefree man living with his mother in Canada, gains superpowers and returns to Punjab to battle drug lords and corrupt politicians threatening his homeland.

title: Toilet: Ek Prem Katha
desc: Keshav marries Jaya and adores her, but their happiness falters when she protests the lack of a toilet at home. As tensions rise, he struggles to appease her with temporary fixes.

title: Baadshah
desc: A small time private detective gets embroiled in an industrialist's plot to assassinate a political leader.

title: Ek Vivah Aisa Bhi
desc: Chandni lives happily with her family and falls in love with Prem, a wealthy man. But on her engagement day, her father dies, and she gives up her love to raise her siblings.

title: Love In Tokyo
desc: Ashok loves Asha, but his mother wants him to marry Sarita. After a tragic accident leaves Ashok blind, his life and relationships become painfully complicated.

title: Laadla
desc: Headstrong factory owner Sheetal marries Raju, the union leader, intending to crush his spirit and teach him a lesson, but their clash soon turns into a battle of wills.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: Mrs.
desc: A young woman marries into a middle-class joint family. Joy fades as endless chores overwhelm her. Determined to reclaim her dreams, she takes bold steps to change her life.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Thalapathy Is The G.O.A.T.
desc: Gandhi, an undercover agent, faces turmoil after a tragic mission. Years later, he encounters a young man claiming to be his son, Jeevan. Secrets unravel as danger looms.

title: Great Grand Masti
desc: Three friends meet Ragini in a small town. Her beauty charms them, but soon they realise she brings danger, mystery, and trouble into their lives.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti fall in love through an arranged marriage. But when Aarti runs away on their wedding day, their lives take a painful and unexpected turn.
